name: @talkersoft-com/agent-arcade
description: Agent Arcade — voice-driven control for your AI agents (Electron UI + a shared Go dictation daemon, NDJSON over a local socket).
author: talkersoft

scripts.build:go: cd go && go mod tidy && V=$(node -p "require('../package.json').version") && CGO_ENABLED=1 go build -ldflags "-linkmode=external -X main.version=$V" -o bin/dictation-go . && codesign -f -s - bin/dictation-go && GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -ldflags "-X main.version=$V" -o /dev/null .
scripts.build:wezterm: cd wezterm-bridge && CGO_ENABLED=1 go build -ldflags=-linkmode=external -o bin/wezterm-bridge . && codesign -f -s - bin/wezterm-bridge
scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run vendor:wezterm && npm run build:go && npm run build:wezterm
scripts.start: npm run kill:prod && npm run build && env -u DICTATE_DEV electron . --launcher
scripts.start:nobuild: npm run kill:prod && env -u DICTATE_DEV electron . --launcher
scripts.prod: npm run kill:prod && npm run build && env -u DICTATE_DEV electron . --launcher
scripts.prod:nobuild: npm run kill:prod && env -u DICTATE_DEV electron . --launcher
scripts.dev: npm run kill:dev && npm run build && DICTATE_DEV=1 electron . --launcher
